    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, m;
    long long t;
    cin >> n >> m >> t;
    int s;
    cin >> s;
    s--;
    
    vector<int> next(n, -1);
    while (t % n != 0) {
        if (s < m) s += t % n;
        else s += n - t % n;
        s %= n;
        t--;
    }
    long long cant = t / n;
    int prevs = s;
    while (cant > 0 && next[s] == -1) {
        for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            if (s < m) s += i;
            else s += n - i;
            if (s >= n) s -= n;
        }
        next[prevs] = s;
        prevs = s;
        cant--;
    }
    if (cant > 0) {
        long long cicle = 1;
        prevs = s;
        while (next[prevs] != s) {
            cicle++;
            prevs = next[prevs];
        }
        long long total = cant % cicle;
        for (long long i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            s = next[s];
        }
    }
    cout << s + 1 << endl;
    return 0;
}
